agent.notes: ExpediaConfiguration is a plain struct with one initializer, so the tests cover the defaults (base URL, unique UUID transaction ID), explicit overrides, empty strings, mutability and value-copy semantics; it has no mapping or failure paths. I ran only `swift test` (16 tests passed), not the verify-swift check.sh.

The type is a pure Decodable DTO (no defaults or mapping logic), so the tests decode through JSONDecoder.expedia to cover full, minimal, optional-nil and missing-required/wrong-type failure paths for HotelListingsResponse and ErrorResponse; the full run reported 25 tests passing.

All 22 tests in the package pass; `Price(_:)` parses only the leading numeric prefix of `Money.value` (so "1,234" becomes 1 and "12 USD" becomes 12), which I pinned in a test and which may be worth tightening in the source.
Listing is a plain value type with no mapping or failure paths, so the tests cover init defaults, stored values, Identifiable id, and Hashable/Equatable per field; all 14 tests in the package passed.

Price is a plain memberwise struct with no defaults, mapping or failure paths, so the tests cover init storage, Hashable/Equatable, Set dedup, unvalidated edge values, and Sendable; all 14 tests in the package pass.
